name: tawsel
description: Tawsel delivery application workspace around the retained routing Engine

scripts.build: npm run build:foundation && npm run build -w @tawsel/api && npm run build -w @tawsel/web && npm run build -w @tawsel/mock-erp
scripts.check: npm run audit && npm run lint && npm run contracts:lint && npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:foundation && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run dev -w @tawsel/api" "npm run dev -w @tawsel/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:foundation && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/api && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/web && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/api-client && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/mock-erp
scripts.test:fast: npm run build:foundation && vitest run --project fast
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration
scripts.test:ci: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:database: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/database-lifecycle.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/command-transaction.test.ts
scripts.test:authorization: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/authorization-schema.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/effective-access.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/authorization-isolation.test.ts
scripts.test:auth: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run apps/api/test/fast/auth-config.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/session-auth.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:auth: npm run build:foundation && playwright test -c playwright.auth.config.ts
scripts.test:provisioning: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/provisioning-actor.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/authorization-isolation.test.ts
scripts.test:intake:b2b: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/b2b-intake-admission.test.ts
scripts.test:locations: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/location-provenance.test.ts
scripts.test:planning: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/planning-jobs.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/planning-publication.test.ts
scripts.test:rounds: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/start-assignment-race.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/round-start-http.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:current: npm run build:foundation && playwright test -c playwright.current.config.ts
scripts.build:foundation: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && npm run build -w @tawsel/api-client
scripts.receiver:demo: npm run build:foundation && node --env-file=.env.database.local --import tsx scripts/receiver-demo.ts
scripts.receiver:package: npm run build:foundation && npm run build -w @tawsel/mock-erp && node scripts/build-receiver-bundle.mjs
scripts.test:browser:source: npm run build -w @tawsel/mock-erp && playwright test -c playwright.source.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:preparation: npm run build:foundation && playwright test -c playwright.preparation.config.ts
scripts.source:demo: npm run receiver:package && node --env-file=.env.database.local --import tsx scripts/source-demo.ts
